title: What if Deception Cannot be Detected? A Cross-Linguistic Study on the Limits of Deception Detection from Text

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot and few-shot classification performance (precision, recall, F1) of instruction-tuned LLMs on balanced deception datasets to quantify their systematic tendency to over-predict the 'truthful' label, and clustering the models' self-reported rationales to reveal their reliance on factual accuracy as a proxy for honesty.

Comparing deception detection performance, error rates, and prompt sensitivities across equivalent English and German datasets (DeFaBel) to assess whether cross-linguistic disparities arise from the predominance of English in model pretraining.
